comparison.objective: Close a stayed tool-chest lid safely while holding its release.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually hold a spring release and control a hinged lid’s descent while avoiding pinch zones.
comparison.success_condition: Lid rests shut without excessive speed or pinch-zone entry; release returns home and hands withdraw.
comparison.reason: The candidate instead mates a jig to a rail and transfers an uncaged recirculating-ball block while preserving continuous support and every ball. Shared bimanual force control does not test the same ability. No missing rubric detail prevents distinction.
